## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Chores**

* **Refactor**

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

This PR upgrades the `@typeberry/native` dependency to version `0.4.0-9b05cc1` across three package manifests and refactors the `bandersnatchVrf.verifyTickets` function to implement batch verification semantics. The API changes from returning an array of per-ticket `{isValid, entropyHash}` objects to returning a single `{isValid, tickets: EntropyHash[]}` object. The result parsing logic is updated to extract a single batch validity flag and chunk the remaining bytes into a ticket array. All callsites in safrole and block-authorship verification are updated to consume the new batch result shape, replacing per-ticket iteration with batch-level validity checks.

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#923](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/923): Adjusts block-authorship ticket verification around the new `bandersnatchVrf.verifyTickets` batch result shape in `verifyAndAddToPool`.
- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#876](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/876): Updates the underlying native bandersnatch binding changes that this PR's API refactor depends on.

**Validate `batchVerifyTicket` hash payload length before decoding**

`packages/jam/safrole/bandersnatch-vrf.ts` decodes `verificationResult.subarray(1)` into `HASH_SIZE` chunks without checking that it matches `tickets.length * HASH_SIZE`. `BytesBlob.chunks()` can yield a smaller last chunk, which will make `Bytes.fromBlob(..., HASH_SIZE)` throw; and if the payload is shorter (but still an exact multiple of `HASH_SIZE`), `safrole.ts` indexes `verificationResult.tickets[i]` without a length check, producing undefined/incorrect ticket IDs. Add the length check before chunking.

<details>
<summary>🔧 Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
   const verificationResult = await bandersnatch.batchVerifyTicket(
     numberOfValidators,
     epochRoot.raw,
     ticketsData,
     contextLength,
   );
   const isValid = verificationResult[RESULT_INDEX] === ResultValues.Ok;
+  const hashesBytes = verificationResult.subarray(1);
+  const expectedHashesBytes = tickets.length * HASH_SIZE;
+  if (hashesBytes.length !== expectedHashesBytes) {
+    return { isValid: false, tickets: [] };
+  }
   // NOTE: in case of failure, the hashes will be all zeros, but we can safely
   // keep the same code path.
-  const chunks = BytesBlob.blobFrom(verificationResult.subarray(1)).chunks(HASH_SIZE);
+  const chunks = BytesBlob.blobFrom(hashesBytes).chunks(HASH_SIZE);
   const results: EntropyHash[] = [];
   for (const entropyHash of chunks) {
     results.push(Bytes.fromBlob(entropyHash.raw, HASH_SIZE).asOpaque());
   }
   return { isValid, tickets: results };
```
</details>

```suggestion
  const isValid = verificationResult[RESULT_INDEX] === ResultValues.Ok;
  const hashesBytes = verificationResult.subarray(1);
  const expectedHashesBytes = tickets.length * HASH_SIZE;
  if (hashesBytes.length !== expectedHashesBytes) {
    return { isValid: false, tickets: [] };
  }
  // NOTE: in case of failure, the hashes will be all zeros, but we can safely
  // keep the same code path.
  const chunks = BytesBlob.blobFrom(hashesBytes).chunks(HASH_SIZE);
  const results: EntropyHash[] = [];
  for (const entropyHash of chunks) {
    results.push(Bytes.fromBlob(entropyHash.raw, HASH_SIZE).asOpaque());
  }
  return { isValid, tickets: results };
```
